title: Why Healthy Habits Are Beautiful
article_en: Hello, boys and girls. We are all different. Some of us love running, and some love swimming. Yes, exercise is very important for us. It helps us stay strong and healthy. We should sleep well every night too. Good habits make our lives beautiful. This is the most important thing we can learn.
article_zh: 你好，孩子们。我们都各不相同。我们中的一些人喜欢跑步，另一些人喜欢游泳。是的，锻炼对我们非常重要。它帮助我们保持强壮和健康。我们应该每天晚上睡个好觉。好习惯让生活变得美好。这是我们能学到的最重要的事情。

grammar_points.name: 动词不定式作宾语
